name: Usage Tray
author: VeigaPunk
description: Bar chip for Codex, Anthropic, Command Code, Grok, Kimi, Cursor, Devin, OpenCode Go, Inception, and the other OMP usage meters. The plugin refreshes its meters itself from omp every 5 minutes, so the chip stays current without any extra system timer.

barWidget.description: Cycle provider usage meters from the bar.
